A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same E2-CSTP research. The text, equations, tables, figures, algorithm and Appendices A–E are readable and support a complete comparison; v2 removes only the appendix contents page.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting results on four datasets, component ablations, runtime comparisons and parameter-sensitivity experiments in Section 5 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original forecasting, ablation, efficiency and parameter-sensitivity results in Section 5 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: The cross-modal fusion, dual-branch causal adjustment, GCN–Mamba architecture, losses and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Specifying the previously unspecified graph-update interval as P=5 documents an existing component without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Terra wind speed, BjTT road velocity, GreenEarthNet vegetation/NDVI and BikeNYC bike inflow. Their modalities, geographical coverage and time ranges remain unchanged in Section 5.1 and Appendix D.1.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains D2STGNN, ST-SSL, HimNet, NuwaDynamics, CaPaint, GPT-ST, UniST, T3 and FNF, with T3/FNF excluded from GreenEarthNet and BikeNYC in both versions. The STED comparisons retain Informer, Autoformer, FEDformer and iTransformer.

E3.justification: The chronological 8:1:1 splits, 12-step input and prediction horizons, metrics, batch sizes and training settings match. The newly specified P=5 interval fills a documentation gap rather than revising a previously stated setting.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same six component ablations, Transformer-module substitutions and lambda/beta sensitivity sweeps in Figures 3, 5 and 7–9. Added explanations do not introduce new ablation or robustness evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, standard deviations or statistical significance tests. The tables and figures retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: Table 1 is numerically unchanged, including E2-CSTP MAEs of 2.43, 3.56, 0.13 and 2.99 across the four datasets. The ablation, runtime, Transformer-substitution and sensitivity results in Figures 3–9 also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, complexity derivation and Appendix B's causal-adjustment argument remain substantively identical. Changing the output-shape notation from N to N_st clarifies the target modality without changing the mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same methodological and novelty claims, including up to 9.66% accuracy improvement and 17.37%–56.11% reductions in computational overhead.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 adds a stability–efficiency rationale for P=5. Sections 4.4 and 5.4 clarify the attribution of speedups to STED, while Appendix D.6 expands explanations linking dataset characteristics and exogenous influences to lambda/beta preferences. Appendix E's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 newly specifies that the adjacency matrix is updated every five epochs; v1 states only every P epochs. This improves implementation specificity. Hardware, software, optimizer, learning-rate schedule and early-stopping details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Chen et al.'s 2024 trajectory-data survey as reference [5] and cites it among surveys in Section 2, where v1 instead references the Terra dataset paper. The broader related-work discussion and research positioning remain intact.

P1.justification: v2 adds several explanatory passages, an acknowledgment section and corresponding-author information, updates the conference designation, and removes the appendix contents page. The main narrative and section organization otherwise remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: The existing figures and tables are retained with limited placement and spacing changes. Figure 3 now precedes its interpretation, Table 3 follows its introductory paragraph, and removing the appendix contents page changes the appendix layout. No scientific figure is added or redrawn.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reproducibility by specifying P=5 and clarifies the efficiency comparison and existing parameter choices. These documentation gains outweigh the small navigation drawback from removing the appendix contents page. The empirical evidence and causal proof remain unchanged.
